title: Are your AI agents actually purchasing data through APIs, or are you still managing subscriptions manually?
author: Free-Band-8923
selftext:
I'm interested in how people building autonomous agents handle paid data.

If an agent needs a new data source, does a human subscribe to the provider, configure API keys, and set usage limits?

Or have you implemented programmatic purchasing, usage budgets, and automatic provider selection?

I'm exploring whether one payment integration across multiple data providers would meaningfully simplify agent development.

What's the most annoying part of your current setup?
